modmenu.descriptionTranslation.hypixel-c: Chat improvements for Hypixel and SkyBlock: channel buttons, player heads in every chat, a bigger chat history and a chat peek key.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.title: Hypixel ChatPLUS
hypixel-chatplus.settings.channels.only_: Hide the buttons on other servers.
Highlight the channel Hypixel reports ("You are now in the PARTY channel"), also when you switch with commands or get moved back to ALL.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.channels.setti: Show a small button after the channel buttons that opens this screen.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.channels.label: Label
hypixel-chatplus.settings.channels.comma:
Run when the button is clicked.
/chat a, /chat p, /chat g, /chat o and /chat coop switch the channel and highlight the button.
Any other command works too, e.g. /p warp or /is.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.heads.resolve_: Guild, party, co-op and private message senders are usually not in your lobby. Look their skin up by name (cached) instead of showing no head.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.heads.system_m: Add heads to server messages. Hypixel sends all chat this way, so keep this on.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.heads.sender_d: Servers can tell who sent a message (UUID). Many, like Hypixel, don't: then the sender is guessed from the text (heuristic).
hypixel-chatplus.settings.heads.smart_he: Stop guessing on servers that are known to report senders. Not used on Hypixel.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.heads.offset_t: "Before Line" only: move lines without a head right so all text lines up.
Empty pixels between the head and the text. 1 matches the text shadow.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.heads.3d.toolt: Draw the hat layer a little bigger so heads look less flat.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.heads.suggesti: Show heads next to player names in command suggestions.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.chat.max_messa: How far back you can scroll. Vanilla keeps 100.
How many of your own messages the up arrow remembers. Vanilla keeps 100.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.chat.keep_on_d: Don't clear the chat when you leave a server.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.peek.enabled.t: Show the whole chat while the peek key is held, without opening the input box. You can keep moving.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.peek.full_heig: Use the taller "focused" chat height while peeking.
hypixel-chatplus.settings.peek.scroll.to: While peeking, the mouse wheel scrolls the chat instead of the hotbar. Hold Shift for single lines.
